name: Craft
description: Create beautifully structured documents, manage tasks, and build a personal knowledge base - all directly from Claude. Give Claude a persistent workspace to save research, draft content, track to-dos, and organize everything into folders, so your best thinking lives beyond the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Craft to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Craft to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.craft.do/my/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Craft MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Craft lists 32 MCP tools, including blocks_get, blocks_add, markdown_add, blocks_update, blocks_delete, blocks_move, blocks_revert, collections_list, collectionSchema_create, collectionSchema_get, collectionSchema_update, and collectionItems_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Craft?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Craft in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Craft requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Craft is developed by Craft Docs Ltd. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
